info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Deposit Lending By Param1-spec
info.description: The Deposit Lending Retrieval API facilitates the retrieval of deposit lending information based on the provided virtual account parameter. This endpoint allows users to gain insights into lending options and balances associated with specific virtual accounts. It primarily serves financial institutions and developers looking to integrate deposit lending features into their applications. Typical use cases include account management, loan assessments, and financial reporting.

get.summary: Retrieve details of a virtual account.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details associated with a specific virtual account in the deposit lending system. You can use this information for various financial operations and to provide insights into the account's status and transaction history.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to fetch details related to the virtual account with ID 'ACC-200045' under the deposit lending operation. Ensure that the JSON structure conforms to the defined schema for a successful request.

200.description: Successful retrieval of the virtual account details.
